title: Trakt Lists no longer work after 24 hours
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

Trakt access tokens only last 24 hours due to a recent change made by Trakt to their API.

As a result, any import lists that use Trakt tokens don't work after 24 hours

Trakt's instructions to app developers is as follows:

```
"We're instead going with a much lower 24 hours and relying on apps to automatically use the refresh_token more often to obtain a new access_token."

Tokens should continue to work up until their expiration date. At that time, your app needs to refresh it and get a new access_token, then use the expires_in value so your app can dynamically handle when to refresh."
```

### Expected Behavior

Access tokens to be auto refreshed using the refresh_token call at the start of the import list job. This will auto refresh the token and allow trakt lists to work for longer than 24 hours

### Steps To Reproduce

Run any trakt based import lists for longer than 24 hours

### Environment

```markdown
Version: 4.0.14.2938
Package Version:4.0.14.2938-ls138 by [linuxserver.io](https://linuxserver.io/)
```
